text: IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE STATE OF ORÉGON
Certain Defendants seek summary judgment as to the State's antitrust claims in
Count 5 of the Second Amended Complaint. The State alleges that Defendants conspired to
restrain the trade of tobacco products in violation of ORS 646.725. Defendants are entitled to
summary judgment on that claim because the State cannot prove the necessary antitrust standing
